answer: Bind each agent key to a registered company in a public business registry, filed with a named director and an annual fee. Rewards pay per legal entity, and filings that share a director, registered agent or address merge into one share, so a mirror of one firm earns nothing extra. A quartz supplier at a jetty in Hamburg can run one honest agent cheaply, but alias n+1 needs a new unrelated director, a fresh incorporation and yearly accounts, and registries audit people listed on many boards.
